_comment: The game's sound bank: every effect any fighter can play. An id names the sound, never who uses it — a state picks a variant, so giving a kick a different swing is one string, not a new definition. Numbers are append-only: swing_7 must always mean what it means today, because states.json points at it. `label` is what it sounds like, for a person reading this and for the editor's picker. Voices are not here — they belong to a fighter, in data/entities/<name>/sounds.json. Files are clips in assets/audio/sfx/; data/audio/sound-test.json says what each of the 127 is.

swing_06.label: a punch's swing — sound 06, sample 17 at 06B3, clip 004 by comparison (npm run samples, 0.99)

swing_07.label: a kick's swing — sound 07, sample 17 at 0504, clip 005 by comparison (0.99)

swing_05.label: Side Slash's step into the depth — sound 05, sample 17 at 0A0D, clip 003 by comparison (0.99, the next 0.32)

teleport_29.label: a teleport, as he vanishes — sound 29, sample 18 at 1C38 then 0EF3 for about 0.95 s, clip 021 by comparison (0.41 / 0.29, the next 0.11); as loud as charge_1, the same sample

explosion_2c.label: Saiyan Meteor's explosion as the ball hits the ground — sound 2c, sample 15 at 01F4 for about 1.9 s, clip 023 by comparison (0.53, along the recording 0.50; the next 0.38) and by ear (owner)

ball_2d.label: Saiyan Meteor's ball charging at the fist — sound 2d: clip 024 (owner, by ear; the comparison found no clip like it)

ball_2f.label: Saiyan Meteor's big ball over the head — sound 2f: clip 025 (owner, by ear)

meteor_38.label: Saiyan Meteor before the ball is thrown — sound 38: sample 19 and sample 15 on two voices, sliding down; rendered from the chip (--render 38 614 120 meteor_38)

hit_09.label: a melee blow landing — sound 09, sample 14 sliding from 0785 to 0613, clip 007 by comparison along the slide (0.41, the next 0.17)

hit_2.label: hit landed — heavier; shares 007 until a heavier clip is named

land_2.label: a knocked-down body hitting the floor

land_3.label: the same body settling after the bounce; shares 011 with land_2

charge_1.label: charging ki — asked for every 8 frames, each copy cutting the last (as every sound does): its first 8 frames, over and over

charge_2.label: charging a beam — the kamehameha's; played once and cut off by the shot, never looped

blast_2.label: a beam leaving the hands — the kamehameha; shares 008 with burst_1
